verdict.stance: Neutral / Morocco's Largest Bank with 36.1% CIR & BB+ Upgrade
verdict.summary: Morocco's largest banking group delivered FY24 Net Banking Income of MAD 34.5bn (+15.2%), a sector-leading 36.1% cost-to-income ratio, and MAD 11.7bn consolidated net profit (22.5% RoaTE), earning an S&P upgrade to BB+ Stable alongside Morocco's sovereign strength.

positives: 36.1% cost-to-income ratio and 22.5% RoaTE on MAD 726.5bn asset base.
S&P upgraded to BB+ Stable; dominant Moroccan + Francophone West Africa franchise.
Established Morocco banking franchise with systemic liquidity access and regulatory oversight.
negatives: Sub-Saharan / UEMOA sovereign and FX exposures across regional subsidiaries.
Limited USD Eurobond float; primary market exposure via local/syndicated debt.
Direct linkage to Morocco sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.

background.business_overview: Morocco's #1 universal bank with pan-African UEMOA/CEMAC footprint.
background.asset_perimeter: Morocco banking/insurance + CBAO Senegal, Attijari Bank Tunisia, SCB Cameroon, Egypt.
background.ownership_governance: Al Mada (~46.5%); Casablanca Stock Exchange listed.

recent_drivers: 2025/2026: S&P upgraded to BB+ Stable following FY24 MAD 11.7bn NPAT and 36.1% CIR.

catalysts.impact: Updates post-2025 CET1, NPLs, and Morocco 2030 infrastructure lending.
Provides audited FY26 figures, updated leverage/capital print, and 2027 guidance for Attijariwafa Bank S.A..

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Strong fee & net interest income expansion with tight cost control.
